title: New Connection Activation Delay Resolution
content:
New Connection Activation Delay Resolution

Document ID: SOP_C22_ACTIVATION_DELAY

Category: C22 — New Connection Activation

Department: Customer Care

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To resolve cases where a new SIM has not activated within the expected service window.

Procedure

Check Activation Status for a rejection or pending-reason code.

If KYC document mismatch is the cause, contact customer for re-submission.

If a provisioning delay is confirmed with no document issue, escalate to Network Provisioning for manual activation.

Target resolution: 48 hours (prepaid), 72 hours (postpaid) from original activation request.
